relations.quote: Do not make me nurse a well man.

story.body: You ate at her table, well. She named the short loaf and the sixpence and did not collect the sixpence. You left the letter where it was and went up to work. You were not going to the Shrew or to the Rose.

relations.quote: Do not make me nurse a well man.
